name: ADB-BINACA
summary: ADB-BINACA (also known as ADMB-BZINACA using EMCDDA naming standards) is a cannabinoid designer drug that has been found as an ingredient in some synthetic cannabis products.7 nM.

pharmacology.text: It was originally developed by Pfizer as a potential analgesic, and is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor with a binding affinity (Ki) of 0.33 nM and an EC50 of 14.7 nM.

uses.text: ADB-BINACA (also known as ADMB-BZINACA using EMCDDA naming standards') is a cannabinoid designer drug that has been found as an ingredient in some synthetic cannabis products. It was originally developed by Pfizer as a potential analgesic, and is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor with a binding affinity (Ki) of 0.33 nM and an EC50 of 14.7 nM.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Like several of its relatives, it started as a drug company's search for painkillers in 2009 and later appeared, unchanged, in synthetic cannabis products.
fact.zh: 和它的幾個近親一樣，它起初是2009年某製藥公司尋找止痛藥的產物，後來原封不動地出現在合成大麻製品中。
fact.zhHans: 和它的几个近亲一样，它起初是2009年某制药公司寻找止痛药的产物，后来原封不动地出现在合成大麻制品中。
